name: Spring Market
about: Half-year pass that opens around Easter. It starts one season length after season 1 (see starts in season_1.json). Mixed rewards in spring colours: eggs, blossom, hares, pastel, a spring-market stall, plus cars, boats, fancy artifacts, XP boosts and small gold in several rarities. kind: badge, theme, namePlate, backdrop, saveSlot, advisorLine, richListFlair, tradePlate (colors for the look, rarity optional), card (card = id in cards.json), artifact (artifact = id in artifacts.json), xp or gold or box (amount). Image: <kind>.<id>.png in App/Ledger/Resources/Content/art.
